snippet.title: Catjinni Demo Launch - Out Now On Steam! Try the magical mayhem today
snippet.description:
Catjinni demo is now live!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3366620/Catjinni_Survivors_Demo/

Meta Quest:
https://www.meta.com/de-de/experiences/catjinni-survivors-demo/8484406335022466/

🔮 Full release expected in Q3 2025

Catjinni is a single-player, survivor-like auto-shooter where you play as a catmage with a loyal catjinn sidekick. Set traps, sling spells, unlock powerful gear, and build your own magical playstyle. It’s fast, weird, and full of feline chaos.

Play the demo now and help shape the future of the game.

Indie devs like me rely on word of mouth — so if you enjoy it, sharing or wishlisting means the world. Thank you!

More Info:
www.catjinni.com
